title: Mechanistic and thermodynamic insights into binding and activation of small molecules on metallozeolites – relevance for adsorption and catalysis

Metallozeolites exchanged with 3d transition metal ions (TMI) are versatile catalytic materials owing to their well-defined framework structures, redox flexibility, and remarkable adsorption and catalytic properties.
